reason: frequency: requires local mode frequency and network oscillation data, not observable in Grid2Op

rule.source: ENTSO-E NC RfG, Article on Power Generating Module Simulation
rule.explanation: A sudden load reduction from 1.0 p.u. to 0.6 p.u. of maximum capacity must not lead to undamped oscillations in active or reactive power.

reason: dynamic simulation: requires time-domain response to load step change, not observable in Grid2Op steady-state variables

rule.source: ENTSO-E NC RfG, Article 11(3)(a)
rule.explanation: Synchronous Power Generating Modules must demonstrate their capability to simulate fault-ride-through in the conditions set forth in Article 11(3)(a).

reason: ride-through: requires fault simulation and trip status/duration, not observable in Grid2Op steady-state variables

rule.source: ENTSO-E NC RfG, Article 10(5)(b), Simulation Requirements
rule.explanation: The Power Generating Module must not disconnect from the island due to over- or under-frequency during active power setpoint changes within the P-Q capability diagram.

reason: frequency: requires frequency/ROCOF observables not available in Grid2Op
